subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Mia's family installed a doorbell camera.”?
options: At first, they used it only to see who was outside.
Phones may be used only during the first and last thirty minutes of the event.
When the shop first opened, she used it to listen to music while making noodles.
Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「At first, they used it only to see who was outside.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Phones may be used only during the first and last thirty minutes of the event.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When the shop first opened, she used it to listen to music while making noodles.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「At first, they used it only to see who was outside.」，答案為「At first, they used it only to see who was outside.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「At first, they used it only to see who was outside.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
